current_evidence: The council's 'Making a planning application' page (worcester.gov.uk/planning/making-a-planning-application) still links 'The City Councils Validation Checklist', which is the same 'Local Validation Document - November 2022' PDF; no newer list was found by search.

issues.detail: Five local requirements in Part Two of the list are absent from Grokbot's rows: Glint and Glare Assessment (proposals with large expanses of glass); Employment Site Assessment (loss of B2/B8 floorspace of 1,000 sq m+ in urban areas or loss of rural B2/B8/tourism/leisure uses, with 12 months' marketing evidence); Retail and Centres Impact Assessment (main town centre uses outside designated centres; retail/leisure over 1,000 sq m net out of centre); Water Management Statement (all applications draining waste or surface water; housing also needs water consumption information); Ventilation/Extraction Statement (new restaurants, hot food takeaways and pubs/bars serving hot food next to residential property - Grokbot only has the separate Odour Impact Assessment under this name).
issues.evidence: Local Validation Document Nov 2022, Part Two headings 'Glint and Glare Assessment', 'Employment Site Assessment', 'Retail and Centres Impact Assessment', 'Water Management Statement', 'Ventilation/Extraction Statement'

issues.detail: Householder is recorded as '(none) - national requirements only', but the list applies several local requirements to householder schemes: Tree Survey/Arboricultural Statement explicitly includes householder schemes, Heritage Statement applies to any application affecting a heritage asset or its setting, Flood Risk Assessment applies in Flood Zones 2/3 including minor development, and Appendix 1 sets householder bat survey triggers. The same blanket '(none)' is wrong for Outline (ecology surveys are expressly required for outline applications), and Listed building consent has only Structural Survey although the Heritage Statement applies.
issues.evidence: Tree Survey section: applies where trees/hedges on or adjacent to site could be affected 'including householder schemes'; Appendix 1: 'Most householder applications will not require the involvement of professional ecologists' but bat survey required for specified buildings/features

issues.detail: About 33 requirements carry 'INFERRED: application type not named ... placed under Full planning', but the document includes a Figure 7 matrix assigning requirements to application types, so the guesses are avoidable. Examples: Structural Survey, Heritage Statement and Schedule of works belong with listed building/conservation area consents; Landscape and Visual Impact Assessment explicitly excludes householder development; Statement of Community Involvement and Planning Statement are for major applications.
issues.evidence: Figure 7 (Part II) table of requirements by application type; LVIA trigger 'Non-householder development in AONBs...'

issues.detail: Statement of Community Involvement and Waste/Refuse storage details are placed under 'Change of use - prior approval'. The source refers to major change of use planning applications, not prior approval. Telecommunications supplementary information is also filed as a change-of-use prior approval, but it relates to telecoms prior approval and full applications (the list cites GPDO 'part 24', now Part 16), not change of use.
issues.evidence: SCI: 'For all major and major change of use applications'; Refuse: 'New dwellings including apartments schemes, change of use applications, retail, and industrial development'

issues.detail: Several trigger excerpts are taken from the wrong section or cut off. Viability Assessment carries the Environmental Impact Assessment trigger text (Schedule 1/2 EIA). Photographs/Photomontages carries the Transport Assessment heading text. Travel Plan's trigger is only a PPG citation and omits the real trigger (mandatory for 50+ dwellings; Welcome Pack for under 50). Economic Statement stops at 'When required' and omits the trigger (employment-generating development, 1,000 sq m+ commercial floorspace, change of use from employment). Agricultural Land Classification gives commentary rather than the trigger (large greenfield solar farms, or loss of over 5 ha of agricultural land or 2 ha of BMV land).
issues.evidence: Viability Assessment source: applies where the applicant says full policy requirements would make the scheme unviable; Travel Plan: 'mandatory for residential schemes of 50+ dwellings'

issues.detail: The Biodiversity Net Gain row quotes 2022 appendix text saying metrics are 'relatively new' and will matter 'when net biodiversity gain becomes a legal requirement'. That is guidance, not a validation trigger, and it does not reflect statutory BNG (in force since February 2024). The list itself predates mandatory BNG, so the workbook should say that BNG validation is governed nationally rather than presenting this text as the local trigger.
issues.evidence: Appendix 1: 'it is likely that the use of Metrics will become a very important part of Ecology Statements in the future, and particularly when net biodiversity gain becomes a legal requirement'

issues.detail: 'Agricultural / rural workers' dwelling appraisal' is an invented requirement with no counterpart in the source. It reuses the identical Agricultural Land Assessment excerpt and duplicates the 'Agricultural Land Classification / Soils' row.
issues.evidence: Source has only 'Agricultural Land Assessment' (solar farms / loss of agricultural land); no rural workers' dwelling appraisal heading

issues.detail: Most tab_items are submission or drawing-practice boilerplate and sentence fragments rather than validation requirements. Examples: file size limits ('Maximum single file size is 10 Mbytes'), file-naming examples ('Plan drawing v1A.pdf or Design and access statement 28102013.pdf'), 'It would be appreciated if the scale of the plans and paper size is no larger than...', the dangling fragment 'These can be annotated or titled...', and page-footer residue in 'All photographs in PDF file format ... 6 Local Validation Document - November 2022 In addition:'. The 'Policy-driven requirements' item is a description of the Habitats Regulations from Appendix 2 (legislation list), not a requirement.
issues.evidence: Appendix 2 'Relevant Nature Conservation Legislation' - descriptive only, no triggers

issues.detail: Block plan/Site plan, Floor plans/Elevations and Fire Statement are national requirements but are listed as local Full-planning requirements. The Fire Statement in particular is a national (Gateway One) requirement and not a local list item.
issues.evidence: Fire Statement text mirrors national DMPO requirement (2+ dwellings, 18m / 7 storeys)

issues.detail: The list is four years old (November 2022) and still cites NPPF 2021 footnotes and GPDO 'part 24'. The workbook correctly flags it as outdated (>2y), but it should also note that BNG and other post-2022 national changes are not reflected in it.
issues.evidence: FRA section: 'In line with footnote 55, page 48 of the NPPF (2021)'

summary: Grokbot's link is the council's current list (Local Validation Document, November 2022, still linked from the 'Making a planning application' page). The extraction misses five local requirements (Glint and Glare, Employment Site Assessment, Retail Impact, Water Management, Ventilation/Extraction), records Householder as having no local requirements, puts nearly everything under Full planning even though the document has an application-type matrix, and has several triggers copied from the wrong section.
